resources.string: Turn this on before reproducing a problem. Logs stay on this device until you choose to share a report. This guide does not turn recording on.
Recording continues when you leave this page. Repeat the action that caused the problem, then return here to stop recording.
Turn this off after reproducing the problem. Wait for preparation to finish, then open the new item in Saved reports.
Open this item to review its summary and prepare an attachment. Reports stay available here after you leave.
Review the report below before sharing. This button opens the system share sheet; you still need to choose a recipient and finish sending.
Save the report to a location you choose. Email and sharing are optional; closing this guide does not send anything.
